purpose: Continuous exact-scope closure queue for every visible fusion/theorem/prior claim, plus material omitted review candidates.

closedproof: Freeze the exact statement, field/model, quantifiers, all guards, normalization and charged costs.
Give a complete derivation or an exact theorem-level dependency with matching hypotheses; record any inherited proof rather than labeling it newly audited.
An independent review resolves every material objection and verifies the corrected statement. Finite checks support but never replace an all-size argument.
The artifact, reference locations and source hashes identify one coherent version; downstream claims and sheet rows agree.
priorityclosed_within_reviewed_scope: Compare actual theorem/model/hypotheses/conclusion with identified primary sources at theorem/full-relevant-section depth.
Record source URLs, inspected sections, exact overlap, exact remaining increment and a dated search boundary.
If a source subsumes the result, label known/corollary. If an increment survives, label candidate priority after bounded review; never certify worldwide novelty from negative searches.
priorityblocked: Name the missing comparator/access/theorem match. Stop repeating the same search without a new source, concrete lead, or changed claim.
Keep proof acceptance independent from priority. Resume on new source evidence or a substantially stronger precisely stated theorem.
experimentneeded: Specify an independently authored implementation/control, exact input domain and pass/fail criterion before execution.
Charge cold setup, coefficient/root generation, routes, all inputs/outputs, storage, fallback and requested precision; verify rejection and degeneracy cases.
A timing/finite experiment closes only the experimental claim it measures; it does not prove novelty or all-size correctness. No supplied code is executed under this task.
conditionalclosed: A conditional implication can be proof-closed with explicit unsatisfied hypotheses. It cannot be relabeled an unconditional construction.
The missing constructive witness or hypothesis gets its own task; stop the implication review unless a new objection arises.
rejected_or_subsumed: Record the counterexample, exact contradiction, model mismatch or theorem-level antecedent.
Preserve valid narrower claims. Do not reopen merely by renaming or combining the same unsupported argument.

cycle_control.selection: Prioritize unresolved proof/contract objections and source-only latest families, then model-matched priority gaps, then targeted experiments. Already accepted scoped proofs are not re-proved every cycle absent a new objection.
cycle_control.after_worker_result: Record exact artifact/hash, changed claim, reviewer response and terminal disposition. Update linked fusion/theorem/prior/catalogue records together.
cycle_control.closedproof: Stop proof review for the frozen accepted statement. Queue substantive extensions separately; retain priority/implementation status independently.
cycle_control.priorityblocked: Stop the same unsuccessful search after recording missing primary source or model comparison. Resume on new evidence, access or a different precise question.
cycle_control.experimentneeded: Stop at a fully specified experiment requiring environment/authorization; do not promise production correctness or timing from paper proof.
cycle_control.conditionalclosed: Preserve the implication; missing witness remains a distinct constructive task.
cycle_control.new_fusion_gate: No new fusion row may be promoted from compatible vocabulary alone. Require explicit compatible contracts, actual new implication, proof and independent review; label classical applications honestly.
cycle_control.stopping_condition: This inventory task stops when all 8+10+12 view records and 178 canonical screen records resolve, material omissions have concrete tasks, and owners/prerequisites are set. The user requested cycle continues through assigned workers; unsolved mathematics is not represented as completed.
